info.title: Vindhem Specification
info.summary: The public contract for a running music-library server.
info.description:
The music-library API defined by the Vindhem Specification.

Development release 0.1.2. Before 1.0.0, patch and minor releases may both
break compatibility; clients must target an exact contract release.

This contract defines libraries, semantic music, ordered collections, staged imports,
managed media, immutable companions, atomic edits and history-bound changes. Accounts,
permissions, chat, playback and external execution remain outside this specification.

The portable v1 schema remains the shared semantic source. URI tokens are transport,
not music identity. Canonical writes require If-Library-Match and Idempotency-Key;
staging uses If-Draft-Match. Custom X-Library-ETag and X-Draft-ETag tokens are not
HTTP representation validators. Library reads disclose their history and revision.
Durable successful results replay; uncertain outcomes are reconciled before reexecution.

Errors before response content starts use ErrorEnvelope except HEAD, which never
has content. No JSON error is appended after binary or SSE streaming begins.
The accompanying spec/vindhem.md defines identity restoration,
admission, retry, expiry, media selection and compatibility invariants.

servers.description: Same origin as the running server.

tags.name: Libraries
tags.description: Library identity, snapshots, lookup, search, and export.

tags.name: Tracks
tags.description: Library-local tracks and the canonical all-songs order.

tags.name: Artists
tags.description: Explicit artist records used by track and album credits.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Ordered playlists, folders, and independently identified entries.

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: Durable staging and explicit commit of media or Portable Libraries.

tags.name: Companions
tags.description: Immutable typed data that references music without changing its schema.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Managed bytes addressed without exposing private storage paths.

tags.name: Changes
tags.description: Revisioned committed effects and live change hints.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Several typed metadata edits committed atomically as one revision.

tags.name: Edit Batches
tags.description: Durable prepare, inspect, revise, and commit for larger typed edits.

get.summary: Read service identity
Read process readiness

200.description: The process can serve requests.

get.summary: Read this contract

200.description: The exact OpenAPI document implemented by the service.

get.summary: Read the Portable Music Library v1 schema

200.description: The normative Portable Music Library JSON Schema.

get.summary: Read service identity and limits
List libraries hosted by this server

200.description: A bounded page of libraries.

post.summary: Create an empty library
post.description:
The caller may supply an unused UUID when preserving the identity of a
Portable Library; otherwise the server generates one. A new library starts
at revision zero and contains no change records.

get.summary: Read one library and its current revision

200.description: The library.
The resulting library and mutation receipt.

delete.summary: Delete a library and its managed media
delete.description: Explicit irreversible deletion removes the hosted library, companions, staging records and unreferenced managed media. It overrides staging lease/record-retention promises, but not retained idempotent outcomes. Serialize with admitted commits and processing using those bytes; wait boundedly or return 409 invalid_state while a commit outcome is unresolved. Never delete inputs underneath unresolved admitted execution.

200.description: Confirmation of the deleted library identity.

get.summary: Read one coherent complete library snapshot
get.description:
Every object and order in the response comes from one revision. This is
the bootstrap and recovery operation; normal browsing should use bounded
queries. Companion objects are not part of a Portable Library snapshot.

200.description: A coherent complete snapshot.

get.summary: Export a metadata-only Portable Music Library manifest

200.description: A v1 manifest generated from one library revision.

get.summary: Export a coherent Portable Music Library package
get.description:
Produces one ZIP containing `vindhem.library.json` and every currently
available attachment selected for export. Unavailable attachments may
remain listed by the manifest but have no corresponding file; semantic
objects are not dropped. Manifest and bytes are pinned to the same
library revision.

200.description: A Portable Music Library package.

get.summary: Search display metadata inside one library
get.description:
Returns lightweight grouped results. Search is library-local and does
not call a global catalog. Ranking may improve without changing result
shapes. Exact object reads remain authoritative. Each group reports its
total; clients page deeper results through that object's list endpoint
using the same `q`.

200.description: Grouped lightweight results from one revision.

post.summary: Resolve ordered local references to complete objects
post.description:
Results preserve input order. An absent object returns `null` in-place;
one missing object does not fail the whole lookup.

200.description: Ordered exact lookup results from one revision.

get.summary: Query tracks in canonical all-songs order

200.description: A revision-bound page of lightweight tracks.

post.summary: Create a metadata-only track
post.description:
This creates semantic track state only. Audio and artwork enter through
an import batch. The server does not merge this record with similar names,
identifiers, fingerprints, or checksums. The track is inserted before
`beforeTrackId`, or appended to all-songs order when it is null or omitted.

put.description: Every current track ID must appear exactly once.

get.summary: Read one complete track

200.description: The authoritative track object.

patch.summary: Update track metadata without changing its identity or media

delete.description:
Every collection entry containing the track is deleted in the same
mutation. Artist and album records remain. Companion references remain
as historical references and may subsequently resolve as missing.

get.summary: Query artists in canonical artist order

200.description: A revision-bound page of lightweight artists.

post.summary: Create an artist
post.description:
Similar names or identifiers are evidence for a caller, not an automatic
merge rule. The artist is inserted before `beforeArtistId`, or appended
to canonical artist order when it is null or omitted.

get.summary: Read one complete artist

200.description: The authoritative artist object.

delete.description:
Deletion returns `409 object_in_use` while a track or album credit points
to this artist. Callers must explicitly edit those credits first; the server
never guesses how to rewrite them.

get.summary: Query albums in canonical album order

200.description: A revision-bound page of lightweight albums.

post.summary: Create an album
post.description:
The album is inserted before `beforeAlbumId`, or appended to canonical
album order when it is null or omitted.

get.summary: Read one complete album

200.description: The authoritative album object.

delete.description:
Deletion returns `409 object_in_use` while a track links to this album.
The server never removes or rewrites track links implicitly.

get.summary: Query collection summaries in canonical sibling order
get.description:
Set `parentId` to a collection ID for its direct children or to the empty
string for top-level collections. Entries are paged separately. A parent
may be a folder or playlist.

200.description: A revision-bound page of collection summaries.

post.summary: Create an empty playlist or folder
post.description:
A parent may be a folder or playlist. The collection is inserted before
`beforeCollectionId` among that parent's children, or appended when it is
null or omitted. Parent links must remain acyclic.

put.summary: Replace the order of top-level collections or one collection's children
put.description:
The supplied IDs must be exactly the current direct children of
`parentId`; that parent may be a folder or playlist. `null` addresses
top-level collections.

get.summary: Read one collection summary

200.description: The collection without its paged entries.

patch.summary: Rename, describe, move, or change the role of a collection
patch.description: Parent changes must remain acyclic. At most one playlist may have the `liked` role.

delete.summary: Delete a playlist or an empty folder
delete.description:
Playlist entries are deleted with their playlist. A folder must have no
child collections; otherwise the operation returns `409 object_in_use`.

get.summary: List a playlist's entries in canonical order

200.description: A revision-bound page of independently identified entries.

post.summary: Append track occurrences to a playlist
post.description:
Each supplied occurrence receives or preserves its own entry ID. The same
track may appear more than once.

put.summary: Replace a playlist's complete entry order
put.description: Every current entry ID must appear exactly once.

post.summary: Move ordered entries within or between playlists
post.description:
Entry identity is preserved. `beforeEntryId: null` appends to the target.
Source occurrence order is preserved when several entries move together.

get.summary: Read one collection entry by its library-wide entry ID

200.description: The exact entry and containing collection.

patch.summary: Retarget one playlist occurrence while preserving its entry ID
patch.description: This is the primitive used for an explicit duplicate-track consolidation.

get.summary: List durable import batches for a library

200.description: A page of import batches, newest first.

post.summary: Create durable staging for audio files or a Portable Library
post.description: Creating or filling a batch does not change canonical library state.

get.summary: Inspect one import batch and aggregate progress

200.description: Current durable batch state.

put.summary: Stage the manifest for a Portable Library import
put.description: Valid only for a `portable-library` batch and replaceable until commit.

200.description: The batch after manifest validation and attachment enumeration.

get.summary: Inspect the stored staged Portable Library manifest
get.description: Read the stored submitted semantic JSON and its draft token from one snapshot, including retained terminal batches. It is not the committed graph or fork destination. Inspect batch state/issues separately; equality of draft tokens establishes a coherent review. No staged manifest returns 404 not_found; audio-files batches return 409 invalid_state.

200.description: Stored staged manifest; structural conformance does not certify every semantic rule or readiness.

get.summary: List staged items and their proposals or failures

200.description: A bounded page of staged items in arrival order.

post.summary: Upload one staged file
post.description:
`packagePath` is required for Portable Library attachments and omitted
for ordinary audio-file imports. The server treats filenames, media
types, and metadata as untrusted claims and processes the item before it
becomes ready.

202.description: The durably accepted item; processing may continue asynchronously.

get.summary: Inspect one staged item

200.description: The exact item, proposal, duplicate evidence, and failure state.

delete.summary: Discard an uncommitted item and its staged bytes
delete.description:
This is the recovery path for a failed or incorrectly uploaded item. A
retained `discarded` audit record replaces its live staging state, its
staged bytes are removed, and the same package path may then be uploaded.

200.description: The retained item audit record in `discarded` state.

put.summary: Replace the proposed semantic result of one ready item
put.description:
This edits staging only. It is where a person or program corrects title,
credits, album links, identifiers, or the intended attachment target
before commit.

200.description: The item with its replacement proposal.

post.summary: Commit selected staged work atomically
post.description:
The server revalidates proposals, links, attachment evidence, and exact-byte
duplicates against both supplied revisions. Media is secured before one
database transaction changes canonical state. For audio-file imports,
eligible items omitted from `decisions` remain staged for another commit.
Portable Library commits are all-or-nothing.

200.description: The committed effects and resulting batch state.

post.summary: Cancel uncommitted work and remove staged bytes
post.description:
The batch becomes terminal `cancelled`; remaining uncommitted items become
`cancelled` and lose staged bytes. Previously committed canonical state is
never rolled back.

200.description: The terminal cancelled batch, including any earlier committed revision.

get.summary: List registered companion data types

200.description: Built-in and independently registered type descriptors.

get.summary: Read one companion type descriptor

200.description: The immutable descriptor for this type and version.

put.summary: Register one immutable companion data shape
put.description:
Repeating the exact descriptor succeeds without change. Reusing the same
type ID and version with a different descriptor returns
`409 identity_conflict`. Registration does not alter a music library.

200.description: The existing identical descriptor.

get.summary: Query immutable companion objects

200.description: A revision-bound page of companion objects.

post.summary: Create an immutable typed object that references music
post.description:
The type must already be registered. Every target and input reference
must resolve at creation and be readable by the caller. Companion
creation never adds fields to the referenced music.

get.summary: Read one immutable companion object

200.description: The companion object exactly as stored.

delete.description: Companion objects are corrected by replacement, never patched in place.

post.summary: Resolve a stable track reference to readable media
post.description:
This selects an available attachment and returns its endpoint. A point or
half-open time range is validated and echoed but the server does not clip,
decode, or transform the audio.

200.description: The selected attachment and validated time selector.

get.summary: Read managed audio or artwork bytes

401.description: Bodyless HEAD failure; inspect status and response headers.

403.description: Bodyless HEAD failure; inspect status and response headers.

404.description: Bodyless HEAD failure; inspect status and response headers.

409.description: Bodyless HEAD failure; inspect status and response headers.

delete.summary: Detach managed media from its owner
delete.description:
The semantic owner remains. Underlying bytes are removed only when no
other attachment privately reuses them.

put.summary: Replace one object's audio or artwork preference order
put.description: The IDs must be exactly the owner's current attachments for that purpose.

post.summary: Move an existing attachment to another compatible owner
post.description:
Attachment identity and bytes are preserved. Audio may move only between
tracks; artwork may move between tracks, artists, and albums. The request
names an existing destination attachment to insert before, or null to append.

get.summary: List committed changes after a known revision

200.description: Ordered retained changes and the current revision.

409.description: The requested history is no longer retained or is ahead of canonical state.

get.summary: Watch committed library changes with Server-Sent Events
get.description: Replay then live ChangeRecord events from the required historyId. A history mismatch returns history_unavailable before streaming. Event type is change; id is historyId:revision. Last-Event-ID must name this history and its later revision takes precedence. Heartbeats have event type heartbeat and no id. After content begins, end a failed stream; never append a JSON error envelope.

200.description: A replay-then-live event stream.

409.description: The requested history cannot be replayed; fetch a snapshot.

get.summary: List durable edit batches for one library

200.description: A page of edit-batch summaries, newest first.

post.summary: Prepare and validate a durable set of typed edits
post.description:
Operations are interpreted in order against `baseRevision`. Preparing a
batch does not alter canonical music or its revision. The response starts
at draft revision zero and is `ready` only when every operation validates.

201.description: The prepared batch, including validation results and predicted effects.

get.summary: Inspect operations, validation, and predicted effects

200.description: Current durable edit-batch state.

put.summary: Replace and revalidate an uncommitted batch's operations
put.description: Replace prepared operations and rebuild validation/prediction. Resubmitting the unchanged fully populated operation list is a no-op. A new replacement containing omitted generated IDs is a new allocation intent; idempotent replay preserves prior allocation. Advance the draft only when staging changes.

200.description: The revalidated batch.

post.summary: Revalidate an uncommitted batch against a later library revision
post.description:
The requested base must be the current library revision. The operation
advances the draft revision only when staging changes and revalidates from the first operation. It
never resolves a conflict or changes an operation silently.

200.description: The rebased batch and its fresh validation result.

post.summary: Commit a ready edit batch as one library revision
post.description: Commit only a ready batch whose immutable history matches the current library history. If-Library-Match must identify that history and its current revision, equal to baseRevision; If-Draft-Match must identify the current batch draft. Execute the same engine as a transaction and return one ordered result per operation.

200.description: Ordered operation results, final batch state, and one mutation receipt.

post.summary: Cancel an uncommitted edit batch
post.description:
Valid only for an active batch. Cancellation advances its draft revision,
makes it terminal, and never changes canonical library state.

200.description: The cancelled batch. Canonical music is unchanged.

post.summary: Commit several typed metadata operations atomically
post.description:
Operations execute in order against one transaction. Any invalid
operation rejects the entire request. A changed transaction produces one
library revision and one `ChangeRecord`, regardless of operation count.
This endpoint cannot upload media, mutate import staging, or execute an
external program.

200.description: Ordered operation results and one mutation receipt.

CoreBearer.description:
Bearer authentication for the Vindhem API, using a revocable credential.
Credential issuance, end-user login, and permission policy are deployment
concerns and are intentionally not defined by the music API.

LibraryRevision.description: Canonical library revision used to produce the response.

LibraryEtag.description: Opaque library concurrency token bound to historyId and revision. Copy to If-Library-Match. This is not an HTTP representation ETag.

DraftRevision.description: Revision of mutable import or edit staging, independent of the library revision.

DraftEtag.description: Opaque token bound to the batch instance and draft revision. Copy to If-Draft-Match. This is not an HTTP representation ETag.

ContentRange.description: Byte range returned for a partial response.

LibraryHistory.description: Hosted history in which X-Library-Revision is interpreted.

RetryAfter.description: Retry delay in seconds or HTTP date. Clients retry an uncertain write with the identical request and key.

Authenticate.description: Required Bearer authentication challenge on every 401.

TrackId.name: trackId
TrackId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

ArtistId.name: artistId
ArtistId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

AlbumId.name: albumId
AlbumId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

CollectionId.name: collectionId
CollectionId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

EntryId.name: entryId
EntryId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

CompanionId.name: companionId
CompanionId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

AttachmentId.name: attachmentId
AttachmentId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

BatchId.name: batchId
BatchId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

EditBatchId.name: editBatchId
EditBatchId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

ItemId.name: itemId
ItemId.description: Transport token for the raw local ID; encode using PathIdToken. JSON bodies and references retain the raw ID.

CompanionTypeId.name: typeId
CompanionTypeId.description: Percent-encoded where necessary; `/` is not allowed in a type ID.

IfDraftMatch.name: If-Draft-Match
IfDraftMatch.description: Exact current X-Draft-ETag token, bound to the batch instance. Wildcards are rejected.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
A high-entropy caller-generated key unique to one intended mutation.
Scope is authenticated principal plus operation ID plus target resource.
Reuse is guaranteed for at least the service-advertised retention period.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the preceding page.

TextQuery.name: q
TextQuery.description: Case-insensitive library-local match over documented display fields.

ArtistFilter.name: artistId
ArtistFilter.description: Keep objects with an explicit credit linking this artist ID. Exact raw string encoded with the same canonical token codec as local-ID path parameters.

AlbumFilter.name: albumId
AlbumFilter.description: Keep tracks explicitly linked to this album ID. Exact raw string encoded with the same canonical token codec as local-ID path parameters.

IdentifierScheme.name: identifierScheme
IdentifierScheme.description: Exact identifier scheme; must be supplied with `identifierValue`.

IdentifierValue.name: identifierValue
IdentifierValue.description: Exact identifier value; must be supplied with `identifierScheme`. Exact raw string encoded with the same canonical token codec as local-ID path parameters.

ParentCollectionFilter.name: parentId
ParentCollectionFilter.description: Empty query value selects the top level; otherwise the exact parent ID encoded with the local-ID token codec.

TargetIdFilter.name: targetId
TargetIdFilter.description: Exact target object ID; valid only with `targetKind`. Exact raw string encoded with the same canonical token codec as local-ID path parameters.

InputIdFilter.name: inputId
InputIdFilter.description: Exact input object ID; valid only with `inputKind`. Exact raw string encoded with the same canonical token codec as local-ID path parameters.

ProducerIdFilter.name: producerId
ProducerIdFilter.description: Exact raw producer/activity ID encoded with the canonical local-ID URI token codec.

ActivityIdFilter.name: activityId
ActivityIdFilter.description: Exact raw producer/activity ID encoded with the canonical local-ID URI token codec.

AfterRevision.name: afterRevision
AfterRevision.description: Return or stream changes strictly later than this revision.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: SSE historyId:revision; revision must be a safe nonnegative integer. History must equal the required historyId query or return history_unavailable. Malformed IDs return invalid_input; the later revision takes precedence over afterRevision.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: One byte range is supported. Ignore unsupported units, valid multiple ranges, and Range on HEAD/non-GET, returning the ordinary complete response. Malformed/unsatisfiable single byte ranges return 416; known total length is reported in Content-Range.

HistoryId.name: historyId
HistoryId.description: History obtained from the coherent snapshot/library. A mismatch returns history_unavailable.

IfLibraryMatch.name: If-Library-Match
IfLibraryMatch.description: Exact current X-Library-ETag token. Wildcards and tokens from another hosted history are rejected.

ServiceStatus.description: Service identity, contract version, and advertised limits.

CoreError.description: An error response using the stable error envelope.

BadRequestError.description: Malformed syntax, unsupported parameter combination, or structurally invalid input.

UnauthorizedError.description: The server bearer credential is missing, invalid, or expired.

ForbiddenError.description: The credential is valid but cannot perform this operation on this resource.

NotFoundError.description: The addressed library, object, batch, item, attachment, or type does not exist.

ConflictError.description: Identity, state, cursor or idempotency conflict. idempotency_in_progress is retryable with the identical request/key and Retry-After; it does not replace the eventual outcome. A retired identity conflict includes details.reason=retired_identity.

PreconditionFailedError.description: A supplied library or draft revision precondition is stale.

PayloadTooLargeError.description: The request or uploaded media exceeds an advertised limit.

UnprocessableEntityError.description: Structurally valid input violates a music, ordering, reference, or staging invariant.

PreconditionRequiredError.description: A required library or draft revision precondition was not supplied.

RangeNotSatisfiableError.description: Malformed or unsatisfiable single byte range. Valid multiple ranges are ignored and receive the complete response. Known size is reported as Content-Range: bytes */N.

Content-Range.description: For known-size attachments: bytes */N, where N is total octets.

TrackMutation.description: The resulting track and canonical mutation receipt.

ArtistMutation.description: The resulting artist and canonical mutation receipt.

AlbumMutation.description: The resulting album and canonical mutation receipt.

CollectionMutation.description: The resulting collection and canonical mutation receipt.

CompanionMutation.description: The resulting companion object and canonical mutation receipt.

DeletionMutation.description: The deleted reference, explicit downstream effects, and mutation receipt.

OrderMutation.description: The resulting order and canonical mutation receipt.

EntryMutation.description: The affected collection entries and canonical mutation receipt.

AttachmentMutation.description: The detached attachment identity, owner, and canonical mutation receipt.

AttachmentMoveMutation.description: The moved attachment, its new owner, and canonical mutation receipt.

AttachmentHead.description: No response content. Content-Type and Content-Length describe the corresponding complete GET representation; ordinary HTTP rules apply. This representation metadata is not modeled as an OpenAPI response header named Content-Type.

TooManyRequests.description: Temporary rate or resource admission rejection. No response stream has begun.

DraftRevision.description: Revision of mutable staging state; independent of canonical library revision.

PartialDate.description: Real calendar date at the available precision; semantic validation also applies.

RangeSelector.description: `endMs` is exclusive and must be greater than `startMs`.

mediaSha256.description: Optional exact-byte evidence for the referenced track media.

href.description: Present only when bytes are available to this caller.

beforeAttachmentId.description: Existing attachment in the destination owner/purpose order, or null to append.

idempotencyRetentionSeconds.description: Minimum duration for which completed idempotent responses can be replayed.

service.description: Exact protocol discriminator shared by implementations of this contract; this retained value is not a product name.

apiVersion.description: Exact implemented SemVer 2.0.0 contract release; MUST equal the served OpenAPI info.version. The route prefix and portable format version are separate.

title.description: A non-blank title, or null to return the library to an untitled state.

files.description: Managed attachments with purpose `audio`, ordered by preference.

beforeTrackId.description: Existing track before which to insert, or null/omitted to append.

UpdateTrackInput.description:
`null` clears an optional value. `albumId` and `albumTitle` may not both
be non-null. Credit and album IDs must resolve in the same library.

beforeArtistId.description: Existing artist before which to insert, or null/omitted to append.

beforeAlbumId.description: Existing album before which to insert, or null/omitted to append.

Collection.description: Folders always have `entryCount: 0` and cannot have a role.

beforeCollectionId.description: Existing sibling before which to insert, or null/omitted to append.

CreateCollectionInput.description: A parent may be a folder or playlist. Parent links must remain acyclic.

UpdateCollectionInput.description:
A new parent may be a folder or playlist and must not create a cycle.
Folder collections cannot acquire the `liked` role.

beforeCollectionId.description:
Reposition before this sibling after applying `parentId`, or append
when null. Omission preserves position unless `parentId` changes, in
which case the collection appends under its new parent.

SnapshotCollection.description: Folders have no entries and no role.

artists.description: Stable artist order retained for round trips; new artists use explicit insertion.

albums.description: Stable album order retained for round trips; new albums use explicit insertion.

affected.description: Other records or orders changed by the deletion.

ownerId.description: Collection or parent collection; null for a library or top level.

parentId.description: Folder or playlist parent, or null for the top-level order.

CollectionEntryCandidate.description: An omitted entryId is allocated once per accepted transaction/prepared operation-list version. Prepared GET results expose populated IDs; rebase and commit never reallocate.

PortableLibraryMode.description:
`replace-same-library` requires the manifest and target to have the same
library ID and replaces its semantic graph and attachments while leaving
its separate companion history intact. `fork-into-empty-library`
requires an empty target and keeps semantic object IDs while using the
target's distinct library ID.
A fork target must be a deliberately new logical library with no current music or companions and no previously observed semantic/companion IDs. Zero current counts alone are insufficient. Title edits do not disqualify it.

destinationCollectionId.description: Optional playlist receiving audio-file results in item order.

CreateImportBatchInput.description:
`destinationCollectionId` is valid only for `audio-files`.
`portableLibraryMode` is required only for `portable-library`.

ImportBatchState.description:
`open`, `processing`, `ready`, `partially-committed`, and `failed` are
nonterminal. `committing` is a durable recovery state while a commit is
in progress. `committed` and `cancelled` are terminal.

historyId.description: Immutable hosting history captured at creation. Drafts never commit or rebase across histories, including when old receipts remain replayable.

ExactByteDuplicate.description: Evidence for an explicit decision, never an instruction to merge records.

NewTrackImportProposal.description:
Related records are created in the same commit and may be referenced by
the proposed track. Repeating an identical proposed ID across selected
items is harmless; conflicting definitions reject the commit.

UseExistingTrackDecision.description: Reuse existing identity for optional playlist placement without changing its metadata/attachments. Exact-byte evidence is not required. Release this item staging-byte reference at the selected commit; omitted items stay staged. To adopt bytes, accept an attachment proposal.

CommitImportInput.description:
`audio-files` commits require one decision for each item selected in this
commit; decision item IDs must be unique. Eligible items not named remain
staged for a later commit. A `portable-library` commit must omit
`decisions` and atomically applies the validated manifest plus every
received attachment; absent attachments remain unavailable rather than
deleting semantic objects.

CompanionTypeId.description: A stable namespaced type name, normally a URN or reverse-domain name without `/`.

schemaUri.description: Optional stable identifier only; the server never fetches this URI.

CompanionBodySchema.description:
JSON Schema 2020-12 for the inline JSON body. `$schema`, when present,
must name that dialect. Every `$ref` must be a fragment beginning with
`#` and resolve within this same schema. `$dynamicRef`, `$recursiveRef`,
and every external reference are forbidden. Registration and validation
perform no network access.
For registered companion bodies, format is annotation-only, including known and unknown names. No instance is rejected because of format. Schemas requiring unsupported vocabularies/dialects are rejected; they cannot enable Format-Assertion. Envelope formats retain their separate normative meaning.

CompanionLink.description:
Stable target or input. Cross-library links are allowed only when the
caller can resolve both libraries. Selectors and `mediaSha256` are valid
only for track references.

activityId.description: Opaque run or activity identity in the producing system.

targets.description: Ordered primary subjects of this object.

inputs.description: Ordered context or source references used to produce this object.

body.description: Inline typed JSON, limited by the service-advertised byte limit.

artifacts.description: Ordered external results with stable IDs inside this object.

attachmentId.description: Hard constraint on an audio attachment belonging to the track.

acceptedMediaTypes.description: Hard whitelist of exact type/subtype values; no parameters or wildcards. ASCII case-insensitive comparison to the selected descriptor type/subtype, ignoring its parameters. Empty matches nothing.

ResolveMediaInput.description: Both digest fields must agree. Choose the first available audio attachment satisfying every constraint; an unknown digest cannot satisfy a digest. Disagreement returns 422 validation_failed; existing track with no match returns 409 unavailable_media. Selector validation is structural only, not bounded by durationMs.

sourceId.description: Transaction or import-batch ID when applicable.

ownerId.description: Collection or parent collection; null for a library or top level.

EditBatchState.description:
`ready`, `invalid`, and `stale` are mutable states. `stale` is the
effective state whenever an active batch base revision differs from the
current library revision. `committed` and `cancelled` are terminal.

operationIndex.description:
Zero-based operation index when the issue is caused by one
operation. Omitted for a batch-level issue such as a stale base
revision.

CreateEditBatchInput.description: historyId must equal the current hosting history. baseRevision is interpreted only in that history. A history mismatch returns history_unavailable; stale base validation remains explicit.

RebaseEditBatchInput.description: historyId must match both the immutable batch history and current library history; rebase never transfers a draft into another hosted history.

historyId.description: Immutable hosting history captured at creation. Drafts never commit or rebase across histories, including when old receipts remain replayable.

predictedEffects.description:
The complete effects predicted for the atomic batch, in operation
order. Populated only while the batch is `ready` or after it is
`committed`; invalid and stale batches expose an empty array rather
than partial effects.

historyId.description: Immutable hosting history captured at creation. Drafts never commit or rebase across histories, including when old receipts remain replayable.

HistoryId.description: Opaque unique identifier for one hosted history. Changes on deletion/rehosting or restore that loses history continuity; never music identity.

PathIdToken.description: Canonical ~ plus unpadded base64url of big-endian UTF-16 code units, no BOM. Preserves isolated code units. Decode once; reject noncanonical bits, padding, odd byte lengths and empty IDs. JSON carries unencoded IDs, even when their spelling resembles a token.

leaseSeconds.description: Captured at creation; null promises no automatic expiry. A successful changed client result leaving the batch active renews from durable completion; admitted partial commit is included; reads/replays/no-ops/background processing do not.

AdmissionLimits.description: Effective server admission limits. Omitted means undisclosed; null means no configured bound. Cannot guarantee lower independent gateway limits. Already accepted state remains readable/exportable.
